review_candidates.description: Design the face of a coffee house that does not exist yet. Coffwa is a coffee house for people who put culture before coffee. Slow, spiced and shared, brewed the traditional oriental way in a copper pot on hot sand. Self-funded and built to last, not built to be sold. WHY WE EXIST We want the people who come to us to find meaning in every cup: in where it came from, how it was made, and the ethics behind it. We are building Coffwa to give people that, and to give it to the team that builds it. We are not a chain, not a venture-capital race, not hustle culture. We are building a future, and we need a designer who can make people feel it before the doors open in 2027. HOW WE HIRE: A TRIAL PROJECT We only like to hire people we have already worked with. So we start with a small, paid, freelance project of one week, two at most. We judge you on the work: how we connect as people, how you handle the task, and the quality of what you make. It goes both ways: you should feel comfortable with us too, and you are free to say no at the end. One thing we promise: your name goes on a permanent credits page on our website for everything you make that we use. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Brand identity: the logo and wordmark, the colour system with exact codes for screen and print, the typography, and a one-page brand sheet anyone can follow - Materials and finishes: specify the real materials that carry the look (copper, plaster, terracotta, timber, linen), with colours, textures and where each would be used in the shop - Takeaway cups: find ready-made, compostable, unique-looking cups we can buy, then design on them: how the logo shines on the cup and how our ethics come across through cute but bold lines. Make 3 to 5 templates so every order is a small surprise - Packaging: bean bags, bottles, boxes and labels, with the print specification a manufacturer needs - The shop: the interior, counter, the copper pot and hot sand brewing station, seating, lighting, signage and uniforms, shown in clear, crisp, realistic renders, delivered fast - Rendering you can trust: use AI to work fast, then check every render against real measurements and tell us what you checked - Digital look: website design, social media templates, menu boards, the app interface and the waitlist page - Later: product design, such as a home brewing machine, a travel cup and gifts - Handover: editable source files, named and organised, and a short weekly note on what is done and what is next YOU ARE - A brand designer who also builds: logos, products and spaces - Fluent in Blender, Fusion or 3ds Max, or any other software that delivers the speed, quality and detail we need - Someone who uses AI so it serves you, not the other way round - At home in Arab culture and in modern international design - Fluent in English and Arabic, written and spoken WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR A creative background, which does not have to mean a degree: interior design, architecture, marketing, graphic design, or a mix, or skills you built yourself. We look at three things: skills (can you do the work?), experience (have you done something that shows you are up to this task?), and character (can you work well with people, as you are? Introverts bring a great deal to a team). If your degree does not match this list, please apply anyway. We are looking for a self-learner who wants to learn, not for credentials. SHOW US - One example of fast, accurate renders you made with AI, and how you checked them - Two projects that show your resilience, your teamwork, how you learned from a mistake, and how you made the best of what you had - Two people we can call THE HONEST PART We cannot fund you full-time now. We pay a fair and generous wage for regular freelance work, from capital we earned slowly and are spending carefully, and we will not promise money we do not have. YOUR NAME STAYS Coffwa will always keep a dedicated page on its website that credits everyone who has worked with us and whose work we have used. The newest names come first. We may also credit you on products, designs, the website and print; we may end those other credits after 5 years, or if the company's design changes drastically, but your place on the website page stays. This is written into your contract. IF COFFWA TAKES OFF If our work together was successful and human-centred, you get priority and the first right to join us full-time, if you want to. YOUR TRIAL PROJECT (ONE WEEK) Show us six small pieces: 1) product design, 2) packaging, 3) a logo, 4) a website page, 5) an app screen, 6) a rendering. Do them at a good level, not perfect or final. Each one can be a rough concept on one page, plus one clear, realistic render of your best piece. We are looking for rigour, skill and clear communication, and the questions you would ask us are part of the test. PAY EGP 5,000 (about $93) for a paid trial project of one week (two at most, and you will not be penalised for taking two). If it goes well, we will discuss ongoing monthly pay with you at interview. APPLY Send your portfolio, your AI render example, your two projects and your two references. Day-to-day tasks include sign contracts with motivated sellers, conducting property and market analysis, and preparing offers aligned with company investment criteria. The role involves managing negotiations, coordinating due diligence, and collaborating with internal team members and external partners such as realtors, cash buyers, and contractors. Experience managing remote workflows, with strong organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills. Knowledge of residential real estate transactions, contracts, and basic underwriting principles. Demonstrated ability to take ownership, work independently, and make data-informed decisions in a fast-paced environment. Prior experience in acquisitions, wholesaling, real estate investment, or related fields is highly beneficial.
